method.slo: p95 >1000 ms or failures/requests >0.10, sustained for three 1-second windows
method.persistence: Every detector uses 3-of-5 persistence, 30-second cooldown and a 60-second persistent-episode recheck. No past alert can suppress notifications forever.
method.matching: one alert per incident, from 60 seconds before onset through 15 seconds after incident end
method.selection: Prefer validation precision and early recall both >= corrected static baseline; maximize 0.65 early recall + 0.35 precision with healthy false-alarm penalty; report if no strict improvement.
method.development_history: v1/v2/v3/v4 tests were inspected development history. V4 initial-warning filtering traded recall for precision and was rejected for deployment. V5 preserves first warnings; its fresh final seeds are generated only after freezing model/policy hashes.

limitations: Synthetic simulator family, not hospital validation
Corrected scheduler applies equally; the learned filter acts only on repeats; prior results are historical
Initial threshold warnings are retained; repeat filtering can still delay follow-up notifications
Generation and intervention effects remain explicitly bounded
Fresh-run results do not establish cross-domain superiority
